nodes.name: Cal.com Booking Webhook
nodes.notes: Cal.com -> Settings -> Webhooks me is node ka Production URL add karo. Trigger events: BOOKING_CREATED aur BOOKING_CANCELLED dono select karo.

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM clients_master WHERE lower(email) = lower('{{$json.attendee_email}}') LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Odoo - Create Calendar Event
nodes.notes: opportunity_id sirf tab set hota hai jab lead already Odoo CRM me convert ho chuki ho aur clients_master.odoo_lead_id us CRM lead/opportunity ID se match kare.

parameters.query:
UPDATE clients_master
SET status = 'Booked',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE lower(email) = lower('{{$('Normalize Cal.com Payload').item.json.attendee_email}}');

nodes.name: Postgres - Mark Booked
nodes.notes: IF lead clients_master me nahi mila (koi row update nahi hui), matlab ye ek naya/unknown booking hai jo form se nahi aaya tha -- Known Limitations me dekho.

parameters.query:
UPDATE clients_master
SET status = 'Nurtured',
    nurture_step = 0,
    last_nurture_sent = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE lower(email) = lower('{{$('Normalize Cal.com Payload').item.json.attendee_email}}');

nodes.name: Postgres - Revert to Nurture
nodes.notes: Cancel hone par lead ko wapas nurture drip me daal dete hain (nurture_step reset) taaki reschedule follow-up ho sake.
